If Windows says "Windows protected your PC", click More info and then Run anyway. The installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows does not recognise it. Signing is being set up.

macOS

macOS 12 or later · Version -

Download for Apple Silicon (M1-M4) Download for Intel Mac

This build is on its way. Check back soon.

The first time you open it, macOS says Apple could not verify it, because the app is not notarized yet.
  1. Drag Acard to Applications and open it once, then click Done.
  2. Open System Settings > Privacy & Security, scroll down and click Open Anyway.
  3. Confirm with your password. After that it opens normally.

Linux

Linux, 64-bit Intel / AMD (x86_64) · Version -

Download AppImage Download tar.gz

This build is on its way. Check back soon.

AppImage: Open a terminal in the download folder. Replace VERSION with the downloaded version, then run chmod +x Acard-VERSION-linux-x86_64.AppImage and ./Acard-VERSION-linux-x86_64.AppImage.
tar.gz: Unpack the archive, open a terminal in the extracted folder containing acard, and run ./acard.

Your data stays yours

Notes live in one folder on your computer (%APPDATA%\Acard on Windows, ~/Library/Application Support/Acard on Mac). Uninstalling keeps it.

Updates itself

The Windows app checks for a new version when it starts and asks you to restart. Your notes are not touched.

Publish when you want

Connect an notes.example.com account from the app to publish pages and keep cloud backups.

Prefer to build it yourself? The source is on GitHub.
